alerts.infoBody: Each role sees only the data it is authorized to access.

supabaseCheck.pageDescription: An internal page that runs a real Server Component query against the local Supabase Data API.
supabaseCheck.resultDescription: The Data API response was verified without creating a placeholder table or bypassing access policies.

emptyState.title: Your workspace is ready
emptyState.description: Content authorized for this role will appear here as each workflow is activated. Placeholder records are never shown in place of the academy’s real data.

privacy.title: Privacy by role
privacy.description: Each portal is designed to show only what its account holder is allowed to access. Authentication and database policies will enforce this in the next phase.

portals.responsiveNote: The same sections remain clear and reachable on phones and larger screens.

dashboard.label: Overview
dashboard.title: Academy overview
dashboard.description: A central starting point for academy operations and indicators once approved data is connected.

applications.label: Applications
applications.title: Enrollment applications
applications.description: Review applications, follow their status, and convert accepted applicants with the right permissions.

students.label: Students
students.title: Student records
students.description: Organized access to student profiles, assignments, and academic status.

users.label: Accounts
users.title: User accounts
users.description: Create, invite, activate, and disable academy accounts from a protected server workflow.

audit.label: Audit log
audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: A protected timeline showing who changed sensitive records, when it happened, and the values before and after.

settings.label: Settings
settings.title: Academy settings
settings.description: Configure the policies and shared values that govern the system once admin access is enabled.

today.label: Today

today.description: A clear starting point for today’s sessions and tasks for students assigned to you.

students.label: My students
students.title: Assigned students
students.description: Follow only the students you are authorized to teach, without exposing records outside your scope.

reports.label: Reports
reports.title: Progress reports
reports.description: Prepare and review progress reports before approval and release to authorized viewers.

availability.label: Availability
availability.title: Teaching availability
availability.description: Manage available teaching times so the administration can build a suitable schedule.

home.label: Home
home.title: Your learning journey
home.description: A calm home for the essentials that support daily learning and follow-up.

progress.label: Progress
progress.title: Learning progress
progress.description: A personal view of progress and the evaluations approved for you to see.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.title: Session schedule
schedule.description: Session times will be shown in the appropriate time zone once scheduling is connected.

certificates.label: Certificates
certificates.title: Certificates and milestones
certificates.description: A safe place to access approved certificates and learning milestones.

children.label: Children
children.title: Follow your children
children.description: Follow only the children connected to your account from one clear workspace.

billing.label: Billing
billing.title: Invoices and subscriptions
billing.description: Follow invoices and payments for your children’s subscriptions once finance is activated.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Contact the academy
contact.description: Reach the academy’s approved contact channels without creating an internal messaging system.

shell.eyebrow: Secure access to your academy workspace
shell.title: Every role reaches what it needs, with clarity and privacy
shell.description: Sign in with your approved account to go straight to your portal without exposing data outside your role.
shell.principle: Identity is verified on the server, and permissions are enforced again inside the database.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email connected to your academy account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send recovery instructions if it belongs to an active account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Set a new password for the account that opened the recovery link.
reset.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters and avoid easy-to-guess words.

status.resetSent: If the email belongs to an account, recovery instructions will arrive shortly. Check the junk folder too.
status.passwordUpdated: Your password was changed. You can now sign in with the new password.

errors.invalidFields: Check the email and password, then try again.
errors.authenticationRequired: Sign in before opening this portal.
errors.accountUnavailable: This account is currently unavailable. Contact the academy administration.
errors.resetRequestFailed: Recovery instructions could not be sent right now. Try again shortly.
errors.expiredLink: This recovery link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.invalidPassword: Make sure both passwords match and contain at least 8 characters.

userManagement.title: User accounts
userManagement.description: Create or invite approved academy users, then control access without deleting their records.

create.title: Add an account
create.description: Choose an email invitation or set a temporary password.

fields.passwordHint: Required only for direct creation; use at least 12 characters.

notices.created: The account was created and can sign in with its temporary password.
notices.invited: The invitation was sent and the account is ready for activation.
notices.disabled: The account was disabled and its sessions were revoked.

errors.invalidFields: Check the account details, role, and temporary password, then try again.
errors.accountExists: An account already uses this email address.
errors.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable the administrator account you are currently using.
errors.requestFailed: The account change could not be completed. No partial change was kept.

empty.title: No matching changes
empty.description: Adjust the filters or wait for the first sensitive operation to be recorded.

forbidden.title: Administrators only
forbidden.description: Events appear here after an authorized administrator signs in. No details are exposed to other roles.

error.title: The log could not be loaded
error.description: Check the database connection and try again.
